Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 13
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread IMDb’s metadata. Despite IMDb showing datePublished as 2019-02-28, the Planner incorrectly replaced the year with “1991” from the film’s title, fabricating a 1991-02-28 release date. This conflation of the title year with the release year ignored available evidence (that Dilan 1991 is a 2019 film) and led to the wrong conclusion that Dilan 1991 came out before Celine: Through the Eyes of the World (2010).
